<p class="source-citation"><a href="https://docs.ogc.org/is/18-062r2/18-062r2.html#toc57">Published source: OGC 18-062r2, 1.0.0 (toc57)</a>.</p>

<div id="mediatypes">
<span id="toc57"></span>
<p id="_396b44e0-69c5-1ea7-a965-e0d24e6e497e">JSON media types that would typically be used in a server that supports JSON are:</p>
<ul id="_b3cd62f3-d140-1d4d-d5cb-30617420f601">
<li>
<p id="_1a0db53d-41fe-a3ed-4c4c-0597ad077720"><tt>application/json</tt> for all resources.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p id="_89c84993-196e-3662-6365-41b9dd571088">The typical HTML media type for all “web pages” in a server would be:</p>
<ul id="_d728aa21-681a-6101-fa2e-7995fc0ab07b">
<li>
<p id="_fa6a5748-b143-05da-06d7-65c76d9902e8"><tt>text/html</tt>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p id="_d2fce334-9ce8-ee34-a298-c8fbc943eb69">The media type for an OpenAPI 3.0 definition is
<tt>application/vnd.oai.openapi+json;version=3.0</tt> (JSON) or
<tt>application/vnd.oai.openapi;version=3.0</tt> (YAML).</p>
<div class="Note" id="_08e867c4-d1f6-afcb-77e4-80a4315ba631">
<p><span class="note_label">NOTE</span>  The OpenAPI media types have not been registered yet with IANA and can
change in the future.</p>
</div>
</div>
